episodes.title: Whither Canada?
episodes.summary: Mozart presents famous deaths. Whizzo Butter is indistinguishable from dead crab. Arthur "Two Sheds" Jackson has only one shed. A joke goes to war.

episodes.title: Sex and Violence
episodes.summary: Sheep attempt flight. Queen Victoria's slapstick past is discovered. Experts wrestle with a religious question. Investigating the "mouse problem."

episodes.title: How to Recognise Different Types of Trees from Quite a Long Way Away
episodes.summary: Inspector Dim cross-examines Cardinal Richelieu. In a world of Supermen, Bicycle Repairman is a hero. A pub patron inquires about candid photography.

episodes.title: Owl-Stretching Time
episodes.summary: A beachgoer seeks privacy for an outfit change. Self-defense class emphasizes fruit attacks. At the bookstore, there is definitely something going on.

episodes.title: Man's Crisis of Identity in the Latter Half of the Twentieth Century
episodes.summary: A team of experts is called upon to confuse a cat. A newsreader announces a newsreader's arrest. A management training interviewee receives top marks.

episodes.title: It's the Arts
episodes.summary: An arts program profiles a forgotten composer. The hygiene squad investigates Whizzo's new confection, Crunchy Frog. A stockbroker leads a dull life.

episodes.title: You're No Fun Anymore
episodes.summary: A camel spotter jealously guards his catchphrase. In a sinister plot to win Wimbledon, dessert-shaped aliens transform humans into Scotsmen.

episodes.title: Full Frontal Nudity
episodes.summary: Mobsters make the army an offer it categorically refuses. An ex-parrot is not "pining for the fjords." Grannies terrorize a once-peaceful village.

episodes.title: The Ant, an Introduction
episodes.summary: An expedition to Kilimanjaro appears doomed from the start. A lumberjack's song takes a confessional turn. Uninvited guests spoil an intimate evening.

episodes.title: Untitled
episodes.summary: Arthur Tree, who is a tree, hosts "It's a Tree." Chartered accountant Mr. Anchovy seeks a career change. Ron Obvious attempts to set a world record.

episodes.title: The Royal Philharmonic Orchestra Goes to the Bathroom
episodes.summary: A murder mystery has no corpse until Inspector Tiger is killed. 18th-century social legislation gets an erotic spin. Housewives reenact Pearl Harbor.

episodes.title: The Naked Ant
episodes.summary: "Mr. Hilter" of the "Bocialists" runs for office. Competition is fierce for Upper-Class Twit of the Year. A minister falls through the Earth's crust.

episodes.title: Intermission
episodes.summary: A couple experiences restaurant abuse. Historical figures including Ivan the Terrible do impressions. The police utilize magic in crime prevention.

episodes.title: Dinsdale
episodes.summary: For quicker service, a housewife chooses death. The Ministry of Silly Walks fields a grant applicant. The crimes of the Piranha Brothers are recalled.

episodes.title: The Spanish Inquisition
episodes.summary: The Spanish Inquisition is unexpected and ill-equipped for torture. Semaphores perform "Wuthering Heights." A court case is conducted by charades.

episodes.title: Déjà Vu
episodes.summary: A look at the work of cash-strapped poet Ewan McTeagle. A milkman-psychiatrist provides diagnoses, cream and yogurt. "It's the Mind" examines déjà vu.

episodes.title: The Buzz Aldrin Show
episodes.summary: Action hero "The Bishop" tries to stop a series of vicar attacks. The Poet Board hopes to get a poet in every home. A nude man objects to titillation.

episodes.title: Live from the Grill-o-mat
episodes.summary: In a show hosted from the Grill-o-Mat, the Society for Putting Things on Top of Other Things disbands. A butcher is alternately rude and polite.

episodes.title: It's a Living
episodes.summary: A school prize ceremony is hijacked. A couple receives dung from the Book of the Month Club. Silly candidates sweep the Sensibles on election night.

episodes.title: The Attila the Hun Show
episodes.summary: Attila comes home to the wife and kids on "The Attila the Hun Show." Killer sheep are on a rampage. Village idiots provide a vital social function.

episodes.title: Archaeology Today
episodes.summary: Height is a critical factor in a showdown between archaeologists. Australian backwoodsmen hunt mosquitoes. Beethoven can't get a moment's peace.

episodes.title: How to Recognize Different Parts of the Body
episodes.summary: An Australian university's philosophy department -- all Bruces -- welcomes a Michael. "The Death of Mary, Queen of Scots" is performed on the radio.

episodes.title: Scott of the Antarctic
episodes.summary: Contractual obligations trouble an epic film production. A pet owner seeks a fish license. Gynecologists vs. Long John Silver impersonators at soccer.

episodes.title: How Not to Be Seen
episodes.summary: A coffee ad campaign is a disaster. Crackpot Religions Ltd. has a variety of options. A government instructional film offers tips on not being seen.

episodes.title: Spam
episodes.summary: The world's great communist thinkers are quizzed about sports. A hospital caters to overactors. The Green Midget Café menu leans heavily towards Spam.

episodes.title: Royal Episode Thirteen
episodes.summary: The show awaits Her Majesty's royal viewing. Welsh coal miners dispute a fine point of history. Lifeboat survivors debate who they'd rather eat.

episodes.title: Whicker's World
episodes.summary: The great Icelandic saga of the Viking known as Erik Njorl carries him to North Malden. Whicker Island is overpopulated by television interviewers.

episodes.title: Mr. & Mrs. Brian Norris' Ford Popular
episodes.summary: A couple embarks on an adventurous expedition. Classic theater performed in a slenderizing garment melts the pounds away. The BBC runs low on funding.

episodes.title: The Money Programme
episodes.summary: A film director is accused of impersonating Visconti. A husband requests meals with less rat. A client pays for a professional five-minute argument.

episodes.title: Blood, Devastation, Death, War and Horror
episodes.summary: A merchant banker tries to grasp the concept of charity. Nature's brutal competition is documented. A pantomime horse becomes an action movie hero.

episodes.title: The All-England Summarize Proust Competition
episodes.summary: Competitors summarize Proust in evening wear. The fire brigade phone keeps ringing off the hook. Anne Elk has a new theory about the brontosaurus.

episodes.title: The War Against Pornography
episodes.summary: Ordinary mums battle strikers, the left wing and artistic indecency. A Gumby's brain hurts. The groovy new Royal Navy insists it is cannibal-free.

episodes.title: Salad Days
episodes.summary: Fictional adventurer Biggles tries to dictate a letter. A cheese shop is oddly uncontaminated by cheese. Sam Peckinpah's new film is true to form.

episodes.title: The Cycling Tour
episodes.summary: On a cycling tour of Cornwall, clueless Mr. Pither ends up on a perilous journey accompanied by a traveling companion with multiple personalities.

episodes.title: The Nude Organist
episodes.summary: Flats built by hypnosis are perfectly safe as long as the residents believe in them. Paraguay is getting warmer during the Hide-and-Seek finals.

episodes.title: E. Henry Thripshaw's Disease
episodes.summary: The Tudor Jobs Agency hasn't placed anyone since 1625. Dr. E. Henry Thripshaw craves the glory and fame of having a disease named after him.

episodes.title: Dennis Moore
episodes.summary: Heavyweights fight to be named Oxford Professor of Fine Arts. Highway bandit Dennis Moore struggles with the complexity of redistributing wealth.

episodes.title: A Book at Bedtime
episodes.summary: Scottish soldiers train to be kamikazes. A man considers using the phrase "No time to lose." Theories of penguin intelligence lead to social change.

episodes.title: Grandstand
episodes.summary: Oscar Wilde and other society gadflies accuse each other of witty remarks. David Niven's fridge presents a prize at the British Show Biz Awards.

episodes.title: The Golden Age of Ballooning
episodes.summary: The surprising history of "The Golden Age of Ballooning" includes Ferdinand von Zeppelin's murderous insistence that his airship is not a balloon.

episodes.title: Michael Ellis
episodes.summary: It's hard to get good service at the ant counter. Her Majesty visits an ant poetry reading. A toupee-less gentleman wants to complain about his ant.

episodes.title: Light Entertainment War
episodes.summary: Heroes of World War II can't decipher fighter-pilot banter. TV programming executives decide the public are idiots. A gentleman enjoys "woody" words.

episodes.title: Hamlet
episodes.summary: Hamlet consults a psychiatrist. A boxer wins the championship despite his lack of a head. Queen Victoria pulls ahead in the Queen Victoria Handicap.

episodes.title: Mr. Neutron
episodes.summary: The search for Mr. Neutron, who plans to dominate the world, stretches from a London suburb to the Yukon, and results in the destruction of earthly civilization.

episodes.title: Party Political Broadcast
episodes.summary: A spoof of British political-party broadcasts includes the finals of "the worst family in Britain" contest, a violent cricket match, and a housewife who revolutionized beekeeping.
